title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
content: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP). Nodal Agency: KVIC / Ministry of MSME. Credit-linked subsidy program to generate self-employment micro-enterprises in non-farm rural sectors. Benefits: {}

title: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
content: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME). Nodal Agency: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI). Provides financial, technical, and business support for micro food processing enterprises under One District One Product (ODOP). Benefits: {}

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
content: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY). Nodal Agency: Department of Financial Services / MUDRA Bank. Collateral-free micro financing for small businesses across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun loan buckets. Benefits: {}

title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (Micro Enterprise Support)
content: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (Micro Enterprise Support). Nodal Agency: Ministry of Rural Development. Subsidized interest loans and revolving funds for SHG-affiliated women entrepreneurs embarking on micro-enterprises. Benefits: {}

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
content: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF). Nodal Agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. Benefits: {}
